7 days | Ol Pejeta, Samburu, Lake Nakuru and Masai Mara

Package overview

Conservancy, dry north, the Rift Valley lakes and the Mara. One long travel day is written into the plan so the rest of the trip is not a rush.

Families and anyone who wants rhinos, northern species and the Mara. Highlights: Rhino country at Ol Pejeta, Samburu’s northern species, A full day in the Mara.

Route Nairobi → Ol Pejeta → Samburu → Lake Nakuru → Masai Mara → Nairobi

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi to Ol Pejeta

About four hours to the conservancy. Afternoon drive. Rhino tracking is requested when the conservancy is running it that day.

Accommodation: Ol Pejeta

02Day 2 | Ol Pejeta to Samburu

Morning on the conservancy. The chimpanzee sanctuary is optional. Afternoon drive north, about five hours, into Samburu.

Accommodation: Samburu

03Day 3 | Samburu

A full day for the northern specials: reticulated giraffe, Grevy’s zebra, gerenuk, Somali ostrich and Beisa oryx, when they are in the area.

Accommodation: Samburu

04Day 4 | Samburu to Lake Nakuru

This is the long day, about six to seven hours. A short lakeshore drive only if you arrive with daylight left.

Accommodation: Lake Nakuru

05Day 5 | Lake Nakuru to the Mara

Morning in Nakuru for rhinos and, when the lake suits them, flamingos. Then about five hours via Narok into the Masai Mara.

Accommodation: Masai Mara

06Day 6 | Masai Mara

A full day of game drives. A Maasai community visit can be added if you ask before the trip. It is paid locally.

Accommodation: Masai Mara

07Day 7 | Masai Mara to Nairobi

Sunrise drive, then five to six hours by road to Nairobi. A light-aircraft seat back to Wilson can replace the drive.

Accommodation: Departure

Where you sleep

Budget is a permanent tent or a simple lodge. Mid-range is an en-suite lodge or tented camp. Luxury is a smaller camp and, where it helps, a flight between parks. The camp names are written on your quote.

What's included

  • Accommodation on the plan we send you
  • Meals noted in the day-by-day itinerary
  • A private 4x4 with a pop-up roof and an English-speaking guide
  • Park and conservancy fees for the places on the itinerary
  • Arrival and departure transfers in the city where the trip starts
  • Bottled drinking water in the vehicle

What's excluded

  • International flights
  • Visas, vaccinations and travel insurance
  • Gorilla and chimpanzee permits, unless your quote includes them
  • Tips, laundry, premium drinks and personal purchases
  • Balloon flights, extra activities and community visits
